'''Vise''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Assigned to [[Search and Rescue Squad 204]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Vise served under [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Elara Dorne]]. When the squad showed up to rescue captured Republic soldiers from the [[Fallenspire Stronghold]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Elara ordered Vise to tend to the wounded.
